topics.title: The Human Body Primary 1 (Basic 1) - Home Economics
topics.content:
HOME ECONOMICS
PREVOCATIONAL STUDIES
FIRST TERM
WEEK 1
PRIMARY 1
THEME - GROOMING
PREVIOUS LESSON - Nursery 1 - Age 3 | Nursery 2 - Age 4 | Kindergarten - Age 3 Scheme of Work and Plan Lesson Notes
TOPIC - THE HUMAN BODY
LEARNING AREA
1. Introductory Activities
2. The Human Body
3. Lesson Evaluation and Weekly Assessment (Test)
PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES
By the end of the lesson, most pupils should have attained the following objectives (cognitive, affective and psychomotor) and should be able to - classify each part of the human body.
ENTRY BEHAVIOUR
The pupils can identify different parts of the body.
INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIALS
The teacher will teach the lesson with the aid of chart showing different parts of the human body with labels.
METHOD OF TEACHING
Choose a suitable and appropriate methods for the lessons.
Note - Irrespective of choosing methods of teaching, always introduce an activities that will arouse pupil’s interest or lead them to the lessons.
REFERENCE MATERIALS
1. Scheme of Work
2. 9 - Years Basic Education Curriculum
3. Course Book
4. All Relevant Material
5. Online Information
CONTENT OF THE LESSON
LESSON 1 - INTRODUCTION
PARTS OF HUMAN BODY
The hair, eyes, nose, chest, belly, hands, legs, etc.
Human body can be group into 3 parts.
1. The Head
2. The Trunk
3. The Hands and Legs
LESSON 2 - THE HEAD, THE TRUNK, THE HANDS AND THE LEGS
1. THE HEAD
For example, the hair, eyes, nose, etc.
2. THE TRUNK
For example, the chest and belly.
3. THE HANDS AND LEGS
For example, the hands, legs and nails.
ASSIGNMENT
Find out from home other parts of -
1. Head
2. Trunk
C. Hands and legs
PRESENTATION
To deliver the lesson, the teacher adopts the following steps:
1. To introduce the lesson, the teacher revises the previous lesson. Based on this, he/she asks the pupils some questions;
2. Displays chart showing different parts of the human body.
3. Lets pupils identify and state different parts of the human body.
Pupil’s Activities - Identify and state different parts of the human body.
4. Uses the charts to describe parts of the human body.
Pupil’s Activities - State the uses of different parts of the human body.
5. Randomly call the pupils to touch or state a particular part of the body.
Pupil’s Activities - Mention and touch the parts of the human body as shown by the teacher.
6. Summarizes the lesson on the board.
Pupil’s Activities - Copy as the teacher writes.
CONCLUSION
To conclude the lesson for the week, the teacher revises the entire lesson and links it to the following week’s lesson.
NEXT LESSON
Parts of the Body Primary 1 (Basic 1) - Home Economics
LESSON EVALUATION
Ask pupils to answer the questions.
1. ________ is the first part of the human body.
A. Head
B. Trunk
C. Hands and legs
2. ________ is the last part of the human body.
A. Head
B. Trunk
C. Hands and legs
3. ________ is the second part of the human body.
A. Head
B. Trunk
C. Hands and legs
Complete the following:
4. ________ is the first part of the human body.
5. ________ is the last part of the human body.
6. ________ is the second part of the human body.
7. ________ is a part of the head.
A. Nails
B. Eyes
C. Chest
8. ________ is a part of the legs and hands.
A. Nails
B. Eyes
C. Chest
9. ________ is a part of the trunk.
A. Nails
B. Eyes
C. Chest
10. Human body can be group into ________.
A. 2
B. 3
B. 4

topics.title: Reasons for Daily Care of the Body Primary 1 (Basic 1) - Home Economics
topics.content:
HOME ECONOMICS
PREVOCATIONAL STUDIES
FIRST TERM
WEEK 3
PRIMARY 1
THEME - GROOMING
PREVIOUS LESSON - Parts of the Body (Primary 1)
TOPIC - THE BODY
LEARNING AREA
1. Introductory Activities
2. Reasons Daily Care of the Body
PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES
By the end of the lesson, most of the pupils should have attained the following objectives - state the reasons for taking care of the body.
ENTRY BEHAVIOUR
The pupils can identify different parts of the body.
INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIALS
The teacher will teach the lesson with the aid of:
1. Illustrative chart or picture of body care.
2. Body care materials such as towels, brush, sponge, comb, body cream, etc.
METHOD OF TEACHING
Choose a suitable and appropriate methods for the lessons.
Note - Irrespective of choosing methods of teaching, always introduce an activities that will arouse pupil’s interest or lead them to the concept of the lessons.
REFERENCE MATERIALS
1. Scheme of Work
2. 9 - Years Basic Education Curriculum
3. Course Book
4. All Relevant Material
5. Online Information
CONTENT OF THE LESSON
LESSON 1 - INTRODUCTION
Displays showing different parts of the body.
REASONS FOR DAILY CARE OF THE BODY
1. To look good and beautiful.
2. To maintain beautiful skin.
3. To prevent body odour.
4. To stay healthy.
5. To prevent skin diseases.
LESSON 2 - DEMONSTRATE HOW TO CARE FOR OUR BODY PARTS
Demonstrate with song -
This is the way we brush our teeth
Brush my teeth, brush my teeth
This is the way we brush my teeth
So early in the morning…
This is the way we wash my face
Wash my face, wash my face
This is the way we wash my face
So early in the morning….
This is the way we comb my hair
Comb my hair, comb my hair
This is the way we comb my hair
So early in the morning…
And so on…
PRESENTATION
To deliver the lesson, the teacher adopts the following steps:
1. To introduce the lesson, the teacher revises the previous lesson. Based on this, he/she asks the pupils some questions;
2. Displays chart showing different parts of the body.
3. Asks pupils to points to a part of the body.
4. Displays chart showing dirty hands, etc.
5. Asks pupils state and demonstrate how to care of our body parts.
Discuss reasons for daily care of the body.
Pupil’s Activities - Demonstrate how to care for each part of the body, working in groups.
6. Discuss reasons for taking care of the our body
Pupil’s Activities - State reasons for daily care of the body.
7. Summary the lesson on the board.
Pupil’s Activities - Copy as instructed.
CONCLUSION
- To conclude the lesson for the week, the teacher revises the entire lesson and links it to the following week’s lesson.
- Next Lesson - Materials Used for Care of the Body (Primary 1)
LESSON EVALUATION
Asks pupils to -
1. identify the different body parts care materials.
2. demonstrate how to care for each part of the body.
3. mention 3 reasons for daily care of the body.
